name: Zul'Gurub: the Delusions vision alone lets its target see the Shade of Jin'do
contract: The Shade of Jin'do (14986) hides under its own invisibility (24307). The Delusions vision (2118511)
now lets its carrier see the shade, so the curse needs no third debuff for it (testers 2026-11-16:
three Delusions debuffs, two in the live logs). The cursed player summons the shade in the fight, as
the hero does here; it stays hidden without the vision, shows while the hero carries it and hides
again once the vision ends, by expiry or dispel alike. Before this change the vision alone revealed
nothing, so the second assertion discriminates.

steps.label: The hero summons a Shade of Jin'do
Let the shade take its invisibility
CONTROL: the shade carries its invisibility
CONTROL: the shade is hidden without the vision
Give the hero the Delusions vision
DISCRIMINATING: the vision reveals the shade
DISCRIMINATING: the vision alone, without a third debuff
the shade hides again once the vision ends
